description: MtaStsEnforcer::new calls TokioResolver::builder_tokio().expect("TokioResolver init failed"). This panics at runtime if /etc/resolv.conf is unreadable or the OS resolver config is malformed — a condition that can arise in container/chroot environments. A constructor that can fail must return Result. Fix: change new() to return Result<Self, ...> and propagate the error to the caller.
title: MtaStsEnforcer::new panics on resolver init failure
